INSERT INTO t_billing_fact_line (id, fact_id, line_no, component_type, payer_role, payer_id, payee_role, payee_id, basis_amount, rate_value, raw_amount, posted_amount, effect_direction, target_bucket, source_rule_type, source_rule_version_id, source_price_id, source_rule_component_id, source_evidence, create_time) VALUES
(#{line.id}, #{line.factId}, #{line.lineNo}, #{line.componentType}, #{line.payerRole}, #{line.payerId}, #{line.payeeRole}, #{line.payeeId}, #{line.basisAmount}, #{line.rateValue}, #{line.rawAmount}, #{line.postedAmount}, #{line.effectDirection}, #{line.targetBucket}, #{line.sourceRuleType}, #{line.sourceRuleVersionId}, #{line.sourcePriceId}, #{line.sourceRuleComponentId}, #{line.sourceEvidence,jdbcType=VARCHAR,typeHandler=com.paytech.billing.core.dal.configuration.SourceEvidenceTypeHandler}, #{line.createTime})
